mapper.insert: insert into user (id, username, password, name, role, account, phone, avatar, points, total_recycle_count, total_recycle_weight, carbon_saved, status) values (#{id}, #{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{role}, #{account}, #{phone}, #{avatar}, #{points}, #{totalRecycleCount}, #{totalRecycleWeight}, #{carbonSaved}, #{status})
mapper.select: select id, username, name, total_recycle_weight as totalWeight, points from user order by total_recycle_weight desc limit #{limit}
